Hospital Grade Breast Pump

How the V1 Pro Compares: Key Specs at a Glance The V1 Pro is the core pump in this collection, and its specifications define what hospital grade performance means in a wearable format. The accessories and bundles below extend and complete that setup. These terms are often confused, but they are not interchangeable. A true "hospital-grade" pump is a multi-user device built for clinical rental settings, with specialized programming designed for mothers with medical necessity. "Hospital strength" describes a high-performance personal pump — like the Momcozy V-Series — that delivers powerful, hospital-strength suction in a portable, single-user format.
